title: EC2 to ECS Fargate Migration
description: Lift-and-shift 20 EC2 instances running containerized workloads to ECS Fargate with traffic drain and cutover

steps.description: Inventory 20 EC2 instances: image, ports, env vars, volumes, resource limits
Create ECS task definitions, services, target groups matching each instance workload
Deploy ECS cluster, Fargate services, and ALB listener rules via Terraform
Register Fargate targets, drain EC2 targets from ALB, monitor connection drainage
Shift 100% traffic to Fargate targets, verify all 20 workloads health-check passing
Run smoke tests, log inspection, metric comparison; confirm 0 errors and <5% latency increase
Re-register EC2 targets, drain Fargate targets, revert Terraform state

rollback_plan.trigger_condition: any workload fails health check within 15 minutes post-cutover
steps: Re-register all EC2 targets in ALB target groups
Drain all Fargate targets from ALB
Revert Terraform apply to previous state
Confirm EC2-based traffic at 100% with health checks passing
